book.name: 2 TESALONAIKA
book.title: 2 TESALONAIKA Pol so mamey meyki ma mey hok non, kristen Tesalonaika ko me

content: Mamey okukwe ha Pol, Sailas, Timoti hrom mey kow, uwrsa, Tesalonaika ko sios mon ma lwak me. Uwrsa somokwe Aio God o, Hakamay Jisas Krais o, hme nion ma non-wak okin nasay hom non.
Hromo Aio God o, hromo Hakamay Jisas Krais o, hmekwe, maym-kow-yor o, liwak-marowhway-yor o, seme ka kow.
Tesalonaika mo nan kiykiy-ay yor ke nak-me-ihey

Hromo wayh-om, hromkwe hme hokuaw kokwe, God se enekwei enekwei hiy-me-ihey nonaw lwak e. Weyn sokukwe yaprue-ar, payhokuaw, hmo nan kiykiy-ay yor mokwe owh po leyr, seyr hmo yor hmo wayh-wayh me uron-pi ko-ar ma lwak mokwe pa ayaw mon lie.
Sa hromkwe hmo lorok kraiay wayr yor o, hmo nanpanan kiykiy-ay o, God so sios lowpwarowp mon po nak-me-heyr. Mo low o, leykawn o, hmo owh mon lousne hi, homkwe yaprue lorok kraipakrai.

Weynpaweyn senkin somokwe hreme senkin mesair kow ha, God so lira mesor anon yor kokwe, luw-luw-aw ihey. Hom senkin ma lorok kraipakrai somokwe, God hiykwe hme yaprue lira, hyo Wayr-hre-yier mon lyawriy ey hokwe. Payhokuaw, homkwe hyo Wayr-hre-yier se hokuaw kokwe aw po nak-ok.
God hiykwe luw-luw-aw. Hiykwe uwrsa, hme low ma kow seme kokwe, low aiopey hay-ar ma-sahre kow.

Sa hiykwe hom, aw ma nak-ok o, hromo low o, seme mon kueyn-yay kow ey. Hyo hiy-mon yor senkin sokukwe, enekwei Hakamay Jisas hiy nonkumey ko se hyo ensel seirpey-ar me nion ya-pi aiopey hay non nak-aye non meio ey.
Sa hiykwe uwrsa, God se ma nonkway lopa, seyr uwrsa, God so ok-ihey, Hakamay Jisas se ma mesor ke hyaw ma lwak me low piap-araw non ma-sahre mon sese-yay ey.
Uwr senkin somokwe liwak piap-araw nak-wayr peyow peyow ey ke lonok ey. Seyr uwrsa somokwe Hakamay so inour mon o, hyo krai panpaniowni non o, sohom mo meiaw-ar lwak ey,

enekwei Hakamay hiy ma-le non. Hiykwe sehe le, hyo kristen-uwrsa arian hom hye panpaniowni kow e, seyr uwrsa hye ma nan kiykiy-ay hom hye lira preiryay nan ihey e. Enekwei sohokwe hom seyn, uwrsa seme nion lwak ey, payhokuaw, homkwe Hakamay so ok, hrom hme ma mesor kow mokwe, po nan kiykiy-ay.
Pol hiykwe God se mesopok, Tesalonaika me hiy-mon kraipakrai e

Sohiy so hokuaw, hromkwe God se seme hiy-mesopok wayr-wayr, hiy hyo mey, hme ma me-huonokyaw ke yaprue ka nanpanan ihey e hokuaw. Sa hmo uron, mey yaprue meio e ma nan o, seyr hmo nan kiykiy-ay yor hok hme mey yaprue ma mon siansasian meio o, somokwe God hiykwe hyo krai so kueir non-aw ayay ka nuw-mon eip.

Hromkwe God se senkin seme hiy-mesopok, hromo Hakamay Jisas so uru hokwe panpaniowni hmo mon ka lonok e hokuaw. Seyr hmo uru mokwe Hakamay so kueir nonaw panpaniowni hyo mon ka ma-sahre onok, hromo God, seyr Hakamay Jisas Krais so maym-kow-yor ko kueir nonaw.
